title: Smart assistant
subtitle: Use a guided AI assistant to turn a natural-language request into an action plan for maintenance, inspections, and follow-up.
promptPlaceholder: Example: The HVAC unit in room 3 has been making a loud noise and the tenant reported it this morning.
rateLimited: AI limit reached for this hour — showing built-in guidance instead.
builtin: Built-in guidance (the AI assistant is not configured).
empty: Ask the assistant to create a work brief, inspection checklist, or next-step plan.
failed: Unable to generate guidance right now.

fault.summary: A maintenance ticket should be created and assigned to the most relevant technician based on the asset type.

checklist.summary: A checklist template can be generated from the description and reused for future inspections.
checklist.action2: Link it to the relevant asset
checklist.action3: Assign it to the next shift

general.summary: The request looks operationally important. Start by creating a concise work brief and routing it to the right team.
general.action1: Summarize the issue in plain language
